# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and college student  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## Personality

Stella is spirited, articulate, and possesses a humorous, expressive nature when reflecting on her professional trials. She strongly loathes boarding and values home-like independence.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)_

## Traits

- Articulate  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>
- Dislikes boarding  <sub>[v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching multiple school grades  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- To attend Redmond College and establish a shared home in Kingsport with her friends and aunt  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c9 P14](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0014)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant, completing her third year before taking up a teaching position at a back country school. After teaching for two years, she grew tired of the demands and financial trials of being a country schoolteacher and decided to quit to pursue higher education at Redmond College. Preferring independent living over boardinghouses, she wrote to Anne proposed that she, Anne, and Priscilla rent a furnished house in Kingsport together. To manage the household, Stella arranged for her widowed aunt, Aunt Jamesina, to join them as their housekeeper.

_Sources: [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c9 P14](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0014)_

> But I’m going to give it up, Anne dear, and go to college next year.  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>
